title: The holding-age and provision-step facts have no column and no list value, no source in the extract set gives their field names, and no source prints the thresholds, the step percentages or the cost-of-carry rate
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (heading RWB-E3-023, its Data table naming recovery_case, timer, v_ace_npa_asset, decision_log_entry and rule_row, and its Story paragraph); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary v8.md (asset fields DF-COL-031 to DF-COL-040, timer fields DF-WRK-027 to DF-WRK-036, DF-WRK-030 timer_type LOV including holding age); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4.md (R-DIS-06, R-DIS-09, and states ASSET_ON_BOOKS and ASSET_HELD); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3.md (feature row FEAT-AST-05); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Physical Schema v6.sql (no CREATE TABLE asset); _work/msr/context/S5.md (two owned tables, asset_sale and listing, and one workflow); WP B2-S5-005 Read only (the FSD S5 and TSD S5 extract files named there are not present in _work/msr/extract)
section: APP s2 Business rationale; s3 Preconditions; s4 Flow steps 3 to 8 and 10 to 11; s8 BR1, BR3, BR5; s9 State transitions; s11 Data; s12.5; s12.7; s13; s14; s19; CON s2, s3, s7 AC2 and AC6, s11 Data, s12.5, s12.7, s13
description: Both slices describe a step whose facts the target data model does not hold in full. The dictionary gives the asset ten fields (DF-COL-031 to DF-COL-040: asset_ref, asset_code, asset_type, transfer_in_type, from_segment, transfer_in_date, book_value, auction_purchase_price, repossessed_date, stock_date) and gives the timer a holding-age value in the timer_type list, but it gives no holding-age column, no next provision step date, no cost-to-date column and no holding-status column, and the physical schema has no asset table at all. R-DIS-09 tests holding_age reaches next_provision_step_date, and R-DIS-06 charges cost of carry monthly, so the two facts exist as rule inputs with no stated home. No source available to this WP prints the provision thresholds, the step percentages or the cost-of-carry rate, and the FSD S5 and TSD S5 files the WP names are absent from the extract set. Both stories therefore keep the age and the next step date as durable workflow and reference facts, write only the asset fields the dictionary gives, request the cost of carry from rwb-payment rather than computing a rate, and mark every name and value they cannot source with the placeholder.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E3-023 Data table lists recovery_case, timer, v_ace_npa_asset, decision_log_entry and rule_row, with no asset table and no provision field; the dictionary's asset block runs from DF-COL-031 (asset_ref) to DF-COL-040 (stock_date) and stops there; DF-WRK-030 lists holding age among the timer_type values; Recovery Workbench Physical Schema v6.sql defines listing and asset_sale and no asset table; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-DIS-09 names next_provision_step_date as a condition and gives no field for it; the extract folder carries no FSD S5 or TSD S5 file.
area: Data model and rule values, S5 rwb-asset
owner_role: S5 rwb-asset service owner with the data steward, the NPA business owner and the rwb-decision rule owner
proposed: Agree the home of the holding age, the next provision step date, the cost to date and the holding status with the DB story of S5, keep the provision thresholds, the step percentages and the rate in the DISPOSAL package as versioned values, and let the verification loop replace the placeholders when the FSD S5 and TSD S5 are placed in the extract set.

title: The trigger, the four consumed owner contracts and the Finance provision feed route have no single source, and the plan records no contract, integration or external dependency for either slice
source: _work/msr/context/S5.md (ownership rows: two tables, six REST operations, one event EV-22, one job JOB-19, one workflow; S5 row of the Architecture v5 slide 13 matrix giving P7, S4, P8 and S9 calls); Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 slide 19 and slide 43 (AssetTakenOn and AssetSold only, IN rows JudgmentRecorded, AuctionResult, ProceedsMatched); 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (heading RWB-E3-023: Acceptance criteria AC1 Given its trigger arrives, Data table, Endpoints, Screen and states, Permission checks); Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 (FEAT-AST-05 runs unattended, systems AMIS, ALS and GL); Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 (R-DIS-06 systems Workbench and Finance provision feed; R-DIS-09 systems Finance provision feed, ALS core and GL)
section: Metadata rows Depends on (build), Contract dependencies, Integration dependencies and External dependencies of both stories; APP s3 Preconditions; s4 Flow steps 1, 2, 7, 9, 10; s10 Authority; s12.2; s12.3; s12.4; s12.5; s12.8; s13; s14; s19; CON s2, s3, s7 AC3, AC4 and AC5, s11 Data, s12.2 to 12.6, s12.8, s13, s19
description: The step has no single stated trigger and its called parties have no published names. Legacy AC1 says Given the data and the rule version this feature needs are in place and When its trigger arrives; the feature extract says the step runs unattended against AMIS, ALS and GL; the rules give R-DIS-06 the confirmation of the asset record and R-DIS-09 the arrival of the holding age at the next provision step date. The target gives this service no event that starts the step (slide 19 IN lists three events, none of them a case state or a confirmation) and no Schedule, so both stories read the step as the confirmation signal forwarded by the parent CaseWorkflow plus the workflow's own durable timer, and declare no event and no Schedule. The step consumes four owner surfaces and the plan's C, I and X rows are empty for both slices: the rwb-source-data data-product read, the rwb-case state read, the rwb-case move answer and the rwb-payment cost-of-carry activity (the S5 row of the slide 13 matrix gives P8 a Temporal and event call). The Finance provision feed that both provision rules name is outside the 19 services and no source gives its transport, its element name or its owner, and the rwb-payment activity, the case-move answer and the data-product read carry no operation name in any source. Both stories record the absence and build against the published documents and their fakes on Day 1 rather than inventing a C row or reading a table.
evidence: Legacy AC1 fixes no trigger beyond its trigger arrives; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 FEAT-AST-05 gives Systems AMIS, ALS and GL and Runs unattended; Architecture v5 slide 19 IN gives rwb-asset JudgmentRecorded, AuctionResult and ProceedsMatched and OUT gives AssetTakenOn and AssetSold; the slide 13 row of S5 shows T at P7 and P8 and E at S4, P8 and S9, and no REST cell; the context pack gives one job, JOB-19, and one event, EV-22; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 names the Finance provision feed in R-DIS-06 and R-DIS-09 with no interface; the plan rows of both slices carry empty C, I and X lists.
area: Contracts, trigger and interfaces, S5 rwb-asset
owner_role: S5 rwb-asset service owner with the P1, P3, P8 owners and the owner of the Finance provision feed
proposed: Let step D1 decide whether the four consumed surfaces become class C dependencies of this key and a Temporal row for rwb-payment, publish the operation and activity names from their owners, and let the Finance feed owner publish the route and the element; until then the stories build on fakes and carry the placeholder.

title: The legacy key carries no requirement id in the story master and the plan carries no requirement for either slice
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (heading RWB-E3-023, metadata table with Epic, Module, Feature, Process, Priority, Depends on and Decision and no Requirement row); Recovery Workbench Business Requirements Program v4 (REQ-S5-003); Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 (FEAT-AST-05); _work/msr/plan/split_plan.json (reqs list of both slices, empty)
section: APP s2 Business rationale; s18 Traceability; the reqs key of both fragments; CON s18 Traceability
description: The traceability of the two stories needs one sourced requirement. The legacy story master of RWB-E3-023 carries no requirement id, the plan's reqs list for both slices is empty, and no TSD row names a requirement for the holding feature, because the TSD S5 file is absent from the extract set. The requirement of the module that names this outcome is REQ-S5-003, Holding age drives re-appraisal and the provision step by rule (Business Requirements Program v4, Must, owner NPA and asset manager, Epic E3), so both stories trace to it and the empty plan list is recorded rather than filled with an invented identifier.
evidence: The metadata table of RWB-E3-023 gives Epic, Module, Feature, Process, Priority, Depends on and Decision only; the plan rows of RWB-S5-E3023-APP and RWB-S5-E3023-CON carry reqs as an empty list; Business Requirements Program v4 row REQ-S5-003 reads Holding age drives re-appraisal and the provision step by rule, Must, NPA and asset manager, E3.
owner_role: S5 rwb-asset service owner with the business analyst
proposed: Trace both slices to REQ-S5-003 and let step D1 update the plan reqs list of both slices.

title: The legacy story, the feature extract and the upstream documents the two slices read are not approved and the realigned stories have no sign-off
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (heading RWB-E3-023, no approval row); Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 (no document control in the extract); Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 (no document control in the extract); Template and Rules v1 R8.1; AGENTS.md rules 9 and 10
section: Metadata row Status of both stories; APP s3 Preconditions; CON s3 Preconditions
description: The sources of both slices carry no approval in this run and the FSD S5 and TSD S5 documents the WP names are not present in the extract set at all. The run of D-RCV-60 has no human approval step, so the missing approval is recorded as an assumption, both stories carry Status Draft (realignment v1) and the work continues. No behaviour and no value of either story depends on a signature, and no status of a source document is changed.
evidence: The legacy master of RWB-E3-023 carries no approval row and no sign-off table; the feature and rule extracts carry no document control block; Template and Rules v1 R8.1 asks every new document for a change-log row naming D-RCV-60 and the tool line; AGENTS.md rule 9 says a missing approval is recorded as an assumption and the work continues in Draft.
owner_role: Solution architect and the business owner of S5
proposed: Keep both stories at Draft (realignment v1) and let the verification loop collect the sign-offs and place the FSD S5 and TSD S5 in the extract set before any status changes.
